name: skillwright
description: Agent skills built to one method, each shipping the four decisions behind it.

plugins.name: skill-design
plugins.description: Decide what an agent skill borrows, what its body must therefore say, and how wide it triggers — before writing it, or as a diagnosis of one that exists. Explicit invocation only.

plugins.name: heuristic-evaluation
plugins.description: Review an existing page or site against Nielsen's ten usability heuristics and WCAG 2.2 AA, reporting only the violations found — and stating that one agent is one evaluator.

plugins.name: prototype-brief
plugins.description: Decide what a prototype must contain before it is drawn — screens against their states, the hypothesis it exists to falsify, and what it leaves out — then hand the table to whatever builds the screens.
